name: maisecrets
description: Keeps secrets and PII out of the cloud model: deterministic detection, a local vault with TTL, placeholders resolved only where the real call happens. Free and open source, by mcpgate.de.

interface.longDescription: A hook blocks a prompt that carries a secret or personal data, stores the value in a local vault with a TTL, and hands the model a placeholder. The placeholder resolves only where the real call happens: in the shell, in an MCP argument, in a file write. Tool output is redacted before it reaches the model. Nothing leaves the machine. Free and open source, by mcpgate.de.
defaultPrompt: Show the maisecrets status for this session
Which references are in the vault, and which have expired
Store the key on my clipboard and give me the placeholder
